analysis: Hourly negative-hydrometeor ceiling coverage for RRTMG4 control history; no model rerun.
case: NCAR WRF developer test 2010061100, MP27, radiation 4/4, MPI4xOMP1; 24h history at 60-minute interval.
history_interval_scope: Exactly the 25 hourly records 2010-06-11_00:00:00 through 2010-06-12_00:00:00 UTC. Counts aggregate sampled gridpoint values across those records only; they do not represent sub-hourly microphysics states or every radiation activation.

pressure_path_assessment.decision: No phasewise negative grid water-path correction was calculated. P, PB, and P_HYD are mass-level pressures; PH/PHB are interface geopotential, not pressure interfaces. No derived layer dp was substituted.
pressure_path_assessment.units_note: Hydrometeor mixing ratios are read from WRF history as kg kg-1.

interpretation_limits: These are RRTMG4 hourly output samples, not the evolving RRTMGP37 state or its failed 00:10 radiation-call input.
Negative counts are classifications by absolute magnitude of negative q against the configured ceiling; no values are called roundoff.
No conversion to water path or integrated mass was made because pressure-interface thickness was not present in the history file.
Counts aggregate 25 snapshots and can count the same grid cell repeatedly across hours.
